incremental.bootstrap_policy: first INCREMENTAL plan requires an explicit start; its ceiling is max(requestedThrough, scoped physical MAX(trade_date)), rejected after logicalDate and capped at five calendar days from the explicit start
incremental.revision_overlap: re-read the checkpoint date and two prior calendar days; with a five-day total cap, advance by at most two days per verified run
incremental.checkpoint_policy: only contiguous VERIFIED/VERIFIED_EMPTY incremental ledger coverage for the same target, route (all-market or exact ts_code), job/schema version, and frozen bootstrap anchor advances the checkpoint; BACKFILL and incomplete runs do not
incremental.target_range_policy: planner freezes targetId into the request, rechecks the physical identity after reading actual scoped QuestDB MIN/MAX(trade_date), and execution plus writer require that same identity; both first bootstrap and later incremental plans use max(requestedThrough, scoped physical MAX) as catch-up ceiling, reject dates after logicalDate, and cap each window at five days; MAX alone never establishes checkpoint coverage
